description: A quoted node's metadata is a map in fz (`%{__fz_span__: ...}`), and Elixir's is a keyword list. A macro that returns a node written as Elixir writes it, `{:%{}, [], [a: 1]}`, fails with `internal/post-resolution-leftover: span fallback stamping failed: invalid any value ref: ExpectedTag` (stamp_meta_span in quoted_expander.rs assumes a map). Macro.escape returns `[]` metadata, so it needs this. Decision (user, option 1): metadata becomes a keyword list everywhere, as in Elixir; the span is an entry of that list. Done when: every reader and writer of quoted metadata uses the keyword list, a macro returning `[]`-metadata nodes expands on interp/run/build (fixture), `quote` output matches Elixir apart from the span entry, and the docs describe the keyword list.
title: Quoted metadata is a keyword list, as in Elixir
